notes.body:
Rapamycin body model
Whole-body model of rapamycin (sirolimus) with the blood circulation, the tissue distribution and the submodels of the intestine, the liver and the kidneys.
The circulating species are whole blood concentrations: rapamycin is bound in the erythrocytes (FKBP12, blood to plasma ratio 36-142), nearly all studies measure whole blood. The blood flows transport the blood concentrations, the plasma concentration is the blood concentration over the blood to plasma ratio BP_rap.
The content of this model has been carefully created in a manual research effort.

body.p: Metabolism of rapamycin by CYP3A5 of the genotype *1/*1 relative to the one by CYP3A4, in the gut wall and the liver. The reference genotype is CYP3A5 *3/*3 (no functional CYP3A5, f_cyp3a5 = 0), the genotype of most Caucasians.
The value of r_cyp3a5 is the result of the fit PK_20261017_094949__24b18, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

parameter.name: rate of the slow binding rap (tissue)

body.p: The release of the bound rapamycin of the tissue limits the terminal phase: the concentrations fall by a factor of about 10 in the first day after a dose (distribution) and with a half-life of about 60 hr after it.
The value of kdeep_rap is the result of the fit PK_20261017_094949__24b18, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.
